items.change: Renamed the Next.js middleware file to proxy.ts and renamed the exported function from middleware to proxy.
items.required_rule: S: guide says the middleware file and export are deprecated and still work
S: publicRuntimeConfig is removed in Next 16 (guide, Removals: Runtime Configuration)

items.change: Enabled Turbopack's development filesystem cache and the React compiler.
items.responds_to: Next.js 16 support for turbopackFileSystemCacheForDev and reactCompiler.
items.required_rule: new opt-in options (filesystem cache for dev, React Compiler)
dependency for the opt-in React Compiler

items.responds_to: Turbopack becoming the default development bundler in Next.js 16.
items.required_rule: S: Turbopack is the dev default; the extra script is redundant, nothing fails

items.responds_to: Next.js 16 generating development route types under .next/dev/types.
items.required_rule: Next writes the .next/dev/types include itself on dev/build

items.change: Reworked the Next ESLint configuration to register the plugin explicitly and spread its recommended rules instead of extending next.flatConfig.recommended.
items.responds_to: The changed Next ESLint plugin configuration API in Next.js 16.
items.required_rule: D: PR step ':bug: Fix eslint config'; the plugin's flat-config export changed in 16 and the old spread no longer loaded

items.change: Introduced a client-side NextLink wrapper and changed website imports from next/link to that wrapper.
items.responds_to: Next.js 16 link usage issues referenced by issues 85604 and 85470.
items.required_rule: D: PR step ':bug: Fix next link import'; workaround for a Next 16 bug (vercel/next.js#85604)

items.change: Wrapped the global-search contents in React Activity, switching between visible and hidden modes based on whether the search is open.
items.responds_to: The React 19 Activity API adopted with the Next.js 16 upgrade.
items.required_rule: adopts React 19.2 Activity, a new feature

dropped.change: Made Header asynchronous, awaited headers(), detected the user agent server-side, and passed the resulting platform flag into the search components instead of detecting it in an effect.
dropped.drop_reason: new feature 18 days later; async headers() already existed in Next 15

dropped.change: Added a production-build input and workflow secret for NEXT_SERVER_ACTIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY.
dropped.responds_to: Next.js server-action encryption requiring a stable encryption key for production builds.
dropped.drop_reason: static server-action key for deployments; no link to the upgrade in the commit or diff

dropped.change: Added a custom LRU cache handler and configured Next.js to use it with cacheMaxMemorySize set to zero.
dropped.drop_reason: custom cache-handler experiment ('Test custom cache-handler'); not caused by the upgrade

dropped.change: Delayed assigning the iframe src until after mount so the iframe load handler runs on the initial render, and tracked its height separately.
dropped.responds_to: The Next.js iframe initial-render/onLoad behavior documented in issue 69736.
dropped.drop_reason: fixes an iframe issue from 2024 (vercel/next.js#69736), not a Next 16 change

dropped.change: Changed the NextLink wrapper to default prefetch to false and removed explicit prefetch={false} props from its consumers.
dropped.responds_to: Changed Next.js Link prefetch behavior and the resulting desire to avoid prefetching all routes.
dropped.drop_reason: reverted by the next commit (K15); net no change

dropped.change: Reverted the default-prefetch=false wrapper and restored explicit prefetch={false} on selected links.
dropped.responds_to: The prior Next.js Link prefetch change caused some links to stop working.
dropped.drop_reason: revert of K14; net no change
